answer: To achieve game-theoretic Sybil resistance, we deploy the walnut signature scheme coupled with a sable slashing deposit matrix. To forge a false identity, an attacker must commit collateral that is forfeit upon duplicate attestation, ensuring that the expected utility of a Sybil assault remains strictly negative. Under these economic constraints, the network achieves Byzantine Fault Tolerance, establishing a unique Nash equilibrium where rational agents perpetually coordinate honestly.
